{"draft": "Packaging Corporation of America — Q2 2026
Results:
- Net sales: $2.5 billion, compared with $2.2 billion a year earlier
- Net income: $192 million, or $2.15 per share
- Net income excluding special items: $210 million, or $2.35 per share
- Earnings per share excluding special items slipped ($.13) from a year earlier
- Acquired Greif operations contributed $.14 of earnings
- Earnings came in $.02 above guidance of $2.33 per share
- Legacy business earnings declined ($.27)
Operations:
- Total corrugated products shipments climbed 24.3% per day
- Legacy corrugated products shipments grew 4.1% per day
- Containerboard production reached 1,415,000 tons
- Containerboard inventory fell 25,000 tons from the first quarter and rose 40,000 tons from a year earlier
- Export sales were reduced by approximately 30,000 tons from first-quarter levels
Segments:
- Paper segment sales volume rose 6.3% from a year earlier
- Facility closure and write-off charges totaled $14.1 million for the quarter
- Wallula mill restructuring charges were $6.3 million for the quarter
- Acquisition and integration-related costs were $3.3 million for the quarter
Outlook:
- Third-quarter earnings expected at $2.91 per share, excluding special items
- Operations include 90 corrugated products plants and related facilities"}
